name: Bauta
description:
Bauta gives what Claude builds a real web link in seconds. Ask Claude to publish a page, dashboard, or web app it just made, and you get back a hosted URL that is yours, private by default.

Claude's built-in share link is great for a quick public preview. Bauta is for when you need more control: every deploy is private (secret-link only) until you choose otherwise. Make it public, password-protect it, or require email verification. Push updates to the same link, or roll back to an earlier version. See view counts. Export or delete everything yourself, any time. Content is hosted in the EU.

Free to start, no credit card. One sign-in creates your account. Paid plans add your own branded subdomain.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Bauta to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Bauta to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://bauta.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Bauta MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bauta lists 21 MCP tools, including bind_data_source, claim_subdomain, delete_artifact, deploy_artifact, export_artifact, export_audit_logs, get_analytics, get_team_analytics, list_artifacts, list_members, list_share_recipients, and ping.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Bauta?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Bauta in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Bauta requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Bauta is developed by Laien AS. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
